page.overview:
Who is Hades?

Hades is a character from the Final Fantasy XI expansion pack Final Fantasy XI: Seekers of Adoulin. He is the main antagonist of the storyline, having been vanquished thousand of years ago by the founder of Adoulin, King August.

Hades has two forms, the first a humanoid form in which he controls Melvien de Malecroix and a second form in which he fights as his true self.
